mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, we are looking at clear conditions near City Hall under a waning crescent moon. Temperatures will drop to an overnight low of 32 degrees, and happily, there is no rain expected overnight.

The city announced that pavement repairs will take place on November 10 and 11, affecting streets like North Nine Mound Road and Morningside Boulevard. Please note that no parking will be allowed from 7 AM to 7 PM while crews complete this work.
There is plenty to do in our community. Catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, visit the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow, or join trivia at Paddy Mac's on November 11.
Regarding local safety, on Sunday, October 25, police responded to a report of a vehicle stopped in an intersection, resulting in an O W I arrest for a 40-year-old Verona man.
You can enjoy today's delicious flavor of the day, Chocolate Volcano. The Verona Culver's is open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a sweet treat.
